column1: # F4; re-keyed by plan_frame.md rev 2.2 §2.4 at unit 3.0a, [rev2 F6, rev2.2
# R10]): the (frame row, method row, renderer row) triples `MFTRACE FDROUTE
# ... row=ROW ren=REN frame=FRAME` may print, the NAMED PIN of the search
# renderer table. The text a FIND site gets is keyed by that triple: the
# frame row is T-FRAME's (window.c Table E: E-find, E-stmt the composer's PF
# block), the method row T-FIND's (finder.c `fd_rows[]`), the renderer row
#   E-find  window.c `ren_search` (B-pair, B-memchr, B-walk, B-hors) and the
#           FUSED row `ren_fused` (B-fn, rendering the whole triple)
#   E-stmt  window.c `ren_search`'s E-stmt rows (their own id; each names the composer's arm)
# HAND-MAINTAINED, and written from the renderer tables, not from the trace.
# A row added to either table adds its triple(s) here in the same commit.
# Reader: tests/memfn/rows_check.py section R: (1) every FDROUTE triple any
# traced compile of the run prints is a line here; (2) a line with a witness
# is printed by its witness (a pcrec compile of `pattern` under `flags`,
# after `-p rx --features all`); a line with no witness (`-`) prints
# UNREACHED, never a pass; (3) THE REFUSAL INVARIANT: a witness compile
# whose refusal names a T-FIND row's routed pick or Table S's refusal is red
# with its own message (plan_frame.md §5 row R). Rows B and C are SILENT
# MOVES that (1)-(2) see: `foo|bar\d` prints a triple other than its line's
#   flags    pcrec flags for the witness compile (space-separated)
#   fused    `YES` for a fused row (it renders the triple whole), else `NO`
